title: Design System: Glow Pro Booking Widget

display.purpose: Hero H1 only; uppercase Anton, second clause in Warm Gold.

title.purpose: Booking card H2 (29px at <=520px) and embed-section H3 (30px).

title-sm.purpose: Done-state heading (gold) and footer business name.

body.purpose: All reading text; 16px keeps iOS from zooming inputs.

label.purpose: Legends, field labels, urgency line; 650 is the house emphasis weight.

shadows.name: bulb-glow
shadows.purpose: CSS .dot bulbs only; colored glow is reserved for bulbs.

motion.name: verlet-strings
motion.value: TUNE {gravity .32, damping .975, windBase .05, windGust .045, windSpeed 1.9, pushRadius 95, push 2.4, carry .16, twinkle .16, snowDesktop 46, snowPhone 18}
motion.purpose: All canvas light strings on one shared rAF loop; IntersectionObserver pauses offscreen; off under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: bulb-on
motion.value: on += (lit - on) * .12 per frame; pop .6 (progress) / .9 (cheer), decays *.9
motion.purpose: Bulb light-up easing for card progress and submit chase (45ms/bulb card, 18ms/bulb others).

breakpoints.name: canvas-phone
breakpoints.value: 700px (canvas width; smaller bulbs, tighter clips, less snow)

modes.name: embed
modes.purpose: Card only, transparent ground, max 480px; posts gpw-height / gpw-done to parent; links target _top.

modes.name: no-urgency
modes.purpose: Hides the holiday urgency line; URGENCY/URGENCY_TEXT constants in the widget script.

components.css: :host{--night:#0d1a35;--card:#122248;--well:#0a1530;--edge:#2e4273;--cream:#f6f0e3;--mist:#b7c3de;--red:#e0262b;--red-hot:#f23a3f;--warm:#ffd27a;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,Arial,sans-serif;color:#f6f0e3}.ds-card{background:#122248;border-radius:22px;padding:28px 28px 26px;box-shadow:0 34px 70px -24px rgba(2,7,20,.8),0 8px 22px -10px rgba(2,7,20,.5)}.ds-card h2{margin:0;font:400 32px/1.02 Anton,'Arial Narrow',sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.01em}.ds-sub{margin:8px 0 0;color:#b7c3de;font-size:15px}.ds-urgent{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin:14px 0 0;color:#ffd27a;font-size:14.5px;font-weight:600}.ds-dot{width:10px;height:12px;border-radius:50% 50% 50% 50%/40% 40% 60% 60%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 40% 35%,#ffb3a8,#ff2d2d 55%,#a30d16);box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(255,45,45,.55);animation:ds-blink 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}@keyframes ds-blink{50%{opacity:.35}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-dot{animation:none}}

narrative.overview: A Jersey Shore winter night: navy sky with light snow, a house whose roofline is strung with C9 bulbs in the logo's red, warm white and blue. The booking card has its own string that lights bulb by bulb as answers become valid. Anton caps carry the voice; a system sans does the work. Three materials: tonal navy ground, glass light (canvas bulbs with additive halos), and warm-white gold as the single UI accent. The same file runs as a full demo page or, with ?embed=1, as the card alone for an iframe.
keyCharacteristics: Navy tonal layering; no black, no white surfaces
Warm Gold is the only state accent
Signal Red only on the one primary button
Motion is verlet physics on one shared loop, not keyframes
House color is the section divider

rules.name: The One Warm Light Rule
rules.body: Every focus, checked, selected and highlight state uses Bulb Warm Gold; no second state accent.

rules.name: The Red Is the Button Rule
rules.body: Signal Red fills the one primary action per view and nothing else; errors use the salmon pair.

rules.name: The Never-Black Rule
rules.body: Darkest value is the well navy; shadows are navy-black rgba(2,7,20,...).

rules.name: The Anton Is Always Caps Rule
rules.body: Anton only at 400, uppercase, headings only.

rules.name: The Only Glow Is a Bulb Rule
rules.body: Colored glow and bloom belong to bulbs; UI controls signal state with a gold border.

dos: Do take colors from :root custom properties; add a variable before a literal.
Do use Warm Gold for every focus/selected/highlight state; 2px focus rings with offset.
Do keep Anton uppercase 400 for headings and the system sans for everything read or tapped.
Do build new decoration from the bulb vocabulary (C9 sprites, .dot bulbs, .lit icon dots), cycling red, white, blue.
Do tune motion through TUNE and keep every canvas on the shared loop.
Do prefix widget CSS gpw- and check it in ?embed=1 on a transparent ground.
donts: Don't use pure black or white surfaces.
Don't use Signal Red for anything but the primary button.
Don't put glows, gradients or colored shadows on UI controls.
Don't start a second animation loop or keyframe the strings; motion must stop under prefers-reduced-motion.
Don't draw divider lines between hero/house/footer; the roof and footer wire are the dividers.
